shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一块空白习题板前，手里拿着粉笔，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank exercise board holding a piece of chalk and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天不讲新课，我们一起做题。
overlay: 辐射防护习题与案例：剂量与风险

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 八张空白题卡排成两行，前五张蓝色，后三张橙色
shots.prompt_en: Eight blank question cards arranged in two rows: five blue cards and three orange cards. No people.
shots.narration: 每道题，都藏着一条安全道理。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一摞空白习题卷，愁眉苦脸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk with a tall stack of blank exercise sheets and looks worried.
shots.narration: 阿杰面对一摞习题，不知从哪下手。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拿着计算器坐到他旁边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits down beside him with a calculator and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：每道题都对应真实工作。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白习题板前点点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of the blank exercise board, tapping it with the chalk.
shots.narration: 我们一道一道来算。

shots.section_title: 习题课：五道计算题，三个案例
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白习题册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank exercise book on a desk.
shots.narration: 这一课是习题课，一共八道题。
overlay: 习题课：五道计算题，三个案例

shots.section_title: 习题课：五道计算题，三个案例
shots.scene: 五张蓝卡依次亮起：尺子、沙漏、盾牌、天平、骨头图标
shots.prompt_en: Five blue cards light up one by one, showing icons of a ruler, an hourglass, a shield, a balance scale and a bone. No people.
shots.narration: 五道计算题，从距离一直算到体内。

shots.section_title: 习题课：五道计算题，三个案例
shots.scene: 三张橙卡：房间、丢失的胶囊、地下室图标
shots.prompt_en: Three orange cards with icons: a room with a wall, a lost small capsule, and a basement. No people.
shots.narration: 三个案例，都来自真实可能的场景。

shots.section_title: 习题课：五道计算题，三个案例
shots.scene: 欣欣摆手示意不要害怕
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw calmly with a gentle smile.
shots.narration: 不用怕，重点是学会怎么判断。

shots.section_title: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高
shots.scene: 一个小点源向四周发光，近处光斑亮，远处光斑暗
shots.prompt_en: A small point source glows in all directions; the light patch close to it is bright and the patch farther away is faint. No people.
shots.narration: 一个点源，光线向四面八方散开。
overlay: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高

shots.section_title: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高
shots.scene: 大小两个桶装着发光弹珠，大桶旁的光更亮
shots.prompt_en: Two buckets of glowing marbles, one large and one small; the large bucket gives off brighter light. No people.
shots.narration: 源越强，剂量率越高。

shots.section_title: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高
shots.scene: 同样的光被摊到越来越大的方格上，每格越来越暗
shots.prompt_en: The same amount of light spreads over a larger and larger grid of squares, each square getting dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: 离远一倍，摊开的面积大四倍。

shots.section_title: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高
shots.scene: 几个不同的源罐，罐盖上图标各不相同
shots.prompt_en: Several small source containers, each with a different simple symbol on its lid. No people.
shots.narration: 每种核素，有自己的发射本领常数。

shots.section_title: 点源：离得越近，剂量率越高
shots.scene: 源罐旁的计算器和卷尺
shots.prompt_en: A small source container next to a calculator and a tape measure stretched out. No people.
shots.narration: 常数3.3乘5毫居里，50厘米处6.6毫伦每时。

shots.section_title: 累积照射：剂量率乘时间
shots.scene: 剂量率表盘图标乘以时钟图标，得到一个装满的杯子
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dial times a clock icon equals a filled cup. No people.
shots.narration: 累积多少，等于剂量率乘时间。
overlay: 累积照射：剂量率乘时间

shots.section_title: 累积照射：剂量率乘时间
shots.scene: 杯子里的水慢慢变多
shots.prompt_en: A transparent cup slowly filling with glowing water drop by drop. No people.
shots.narration: 站得越久，杯子装得越满。

shots.section_title: 累积照射：剂量率乘时间
shots.scene: 小研在空白本上把一个图标换成另一个图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank notebook, turning one blank icon into another with an arrow.
shots.narration: 算出照射量后，还要换算成剂量。

shots.section_title: 累积照射：剂量率乘时间
shots.scene: 欣欣举着两张空白单位卡并排
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank unit cards side by side with an equals sign between them.
shots.narration: 停两小时累积13.2毫伦，按1伦琴约合1雷姆。

shots.section_title: 求安全距离：退一步，降很多
shots.scene: 一条警戒线画在地上，小人站在线外
shots.prompt_en: A line drawn on the floor around a source; a simple stick figure stands outside the line. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来问：站多远才够安全？
overlay: 求安全距离：退一步，降很多

shots.section_title: 求安全距离：退一步，降很多
shots.scene: 小人往后退了不到一倍距离，表盘指针大幅下降
shots.prompt_en: A stick figure steps back less than double the distance; a dial needle drops sharply. No people.
shots.narration: 限2毫伦每时，退到约90.8厘米即可。

shots.section_title: 求安全距离：退一步，降很多
shots.scene: 尺子图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A ruler icon with a big green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不到一倍距离，剂量率降到约三分之一。

shots.section_title: 离得近，时间短也未必少
shots.scene: 两个小人：一个离源远、旁边长时钟；一个离源近、旁边短时钟
shots.prompt_en: Two stick figures: one stands far from a source with a long clock beside it, the other stands close with a short clock. No people.
shots.narration: 一人站远久一点，一人站近快一点。
overlay: 离得近，时间短也未必少

shots.section_title: 离得近，时间短也未必少
shots.scene: 两只杯子，近处那人的杯子反而更满
shots.prompt_en: Two cups side by side; the cup of the closer stick figure is fuller. No people.
shots.narration: 30厘米处只待一小时，却受照18.3毫伦。

shots.section_title: 离得近，时间短也未必少
shots.scene: 老周拍拍阿杰的肩
shots.prompt_en: The older man pats the young male student on the shoulder in a lab, smiling knowingly.
shots.narration: 时间和距离，要一起考虑。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出
shots.scene: 沙漏里的沙往下漏，旁边一个水龙头在排水
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass with sand falling, next to a drain where water flows out. No people.
shots.narration: 进入体内的核素，有两条减少路径。
overlay: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出
shots.scene: 沙漏图标标“衰变”，排水图标标“排出”
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: an hourglass and a draining sink. No people.
shots.narration: 一是自己衰变，二是身体排出。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出
shots.scene: 两个出口同时开，水位下降更快
shots.prompt_en: A water tank with two outlets open at once; the water level drops faster. No people.
shots.narration: 两条路一起走，减得比任何一条快。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出
shots.scene: 甲状腺图标旁一个小时钟
shots.prompt_en: A thyroid gland icon with one small clock beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 碘-131在甲状腺，有效半衰期7.29天。

shots.section_title: 有效半衰期：衰变加排出
shots.scene: 两只水箱，排水口大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Two water tanks, one with a big outlet and one with a small outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 不同器官排出快慢不同，另一组织3.74天。

shots.section_title: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，颈部的小器官发出明亮的光
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a small organ at the neck glowing brightly while the rest of the body is dim. No people.
shots.narration: 碘进入体内，会大量聚到甲状腺。
overlay: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗

shots.section_title: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗
shots.scene: 天平：一边是小小的器官，一边是整个人体
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: a tiny organ on one side and a whole human body outline on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 甲状腺很小，分到的能量却很集中。

shots.section_title: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗
shots.scene: 一只小杯装满光，一个大池子只有淡淡的光
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cup brimming with light next to a large pool with only faint light. No people.
shots.narration: 单位质量的剂量，高出好多倍。

shots.section_title: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗
shots.scene: 医生图标对准颈部器官，旁边一个靶心
shots.prompt_en: A target bullseye icon aimed at the small neck organ of a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 370兆贝可即10毫居里，这正是碘治疗原理。

shots.section_title: 甲状腺浓聚碘：内照射与靶向治疗
shots.scene: 放大镜对准人体轮廓中的几个器官
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moving over several organs inside a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 算内照射，先看核素聚在哪里。

shots.section_title: 半值层和十值层
shots.scene: 一束光穿过一块砖，出来后只剩一半亮
shots.prompt_en: A beam of light passes through one brick and comes out half as bright. No people.
shots.narration: 能让射线减半的厚度，叫半值层。
overlay: 半值层和十值层

shots.section_title: 半值层和十值层
shots.scene: 一束光穿过更厚的砖，只剩十分之一
shots.prompt_en: A beam passes through a thicker brick and comes out one tenth as bright. No people.
shots.narration: 减到十分之一的厚度，叫十值层。

shots.section_title: 半值层和十值层
shots.scene: 七块砖排成一排，光线越来越细
shots.prompt_en: Seven bricks in a row; the beam becomes thinner after each brick. No people.
shots.narration: 一层减一半，叠起来减得飞快。

shots.section_title: 需要几个半值层
shots.scene: 表盘从红区指向绿区，旁边一叠砖
shots.prompt_en: A dial with its needle moving from the red zone to the green zone, next to a stack of bricks. No people.
shots.narration: 先算要减弱多少倍。
overlay: 需要几个半值层

shots.section_title: 需要几个半值层
shots.scene: 折纸一次次对折，越来越小
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper folded in half again and again, getting smaller each time. No people.
shots.narration: 1200降到10毫伦每时，要减弱约120倍。

shots.section_title: 需要几个半值层
shots.scene: 计数到一半的砖块，欣欣补上一块
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot adds one extra brick to a stack, rounding it up.
shots.narration: 算出6.91个，取7个，减弱128倍。

shots.section_title: 需要几个半值层
shots.scene: 砖块数乘一块砖的厚度，得到一面墙
shots.prompt_en: Several bricks combine into a wall; a ruler measures its total thickness. No people.
shots.narration: 每层1.2厘米铅，共需8.4厘米。

shots.section_title: 核对屏蔽数据：窄束与宽束
shots.scene: 一本空白数据手册和一个计算器图标，中间一个约等号
shots.prompt_en: A blank data handbook and a calculator icon with an approximately-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 自己算出1.037厘米，比给定值小。
overlay: 核对屏蔽数据：窄束与宽束

shots.section_title: 核对屏蔽数据：窄束与宽束
shots.scene: 细光束直穿铅块；宽光束穿过时有散射小箭头又折回来
shots.prompt_en: A narrow beam passes straight through a lead block; a broad beam passing through produces small scattered arrows that bounce back into the beam. No people.
shots.narration: 宽束里有散射回来的射线，会更多。

shots.section_title: 核对屏蔽数据：窄束与宽束
shots.scene: 欣欣指着手册上的空白页点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank page of the handbook and nods.
shots.narration: 设计屏蔽，要把散射也考虑进去。

shots.section_title: 铅还是混凝土：屏蔽是综合取舍
shots.scene: 薄薄的铅墙和厚厚的混凝土墙并排，挡住同样的光
shots.prompt_en: A thin lead wall and a much thicker concrete wall side by side, both blocking the same beam. No people.
shots.narration: 挡同样的射线，混凝土要厚得多。
overlay: 铅还是混凝土：屏蔽是综合取舍

shots.section_title: 铅还是混凝土：屏蔽是综合取舍
shots.scene: 混凝土墙旁一个小钱袋，铅墙旁一个大钱袋
shots.prompt_en: A small money bag beside the concrete wall and a large money bag beside the lead wall. No people.
shots.narration: 可混凝土便宜，还能当墙承重。

shots.section_title: 铅还是混凝土：屏蔽是综合取舍
shots.scene: 天平上放着钱袋、尺子、砝码和房子图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale holding icons of a money bag, a ruler, a weight and a house. No people.
shots.narration: 成本、空间、重量、结构，要综合权衡。

shots.section_title: 铅还是混凝土：屏蔽是综合取舍
shots.scene: 混凝土墙旁一把卷尺
shots.prompt_en: A thick concrete wall with a tape measure stretched across its width. No people.
shots.narration: 铅效率约是混凝土5倍，混凝土要42.1厘米。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：看射线种类
shots.scene: 一位工作人员图标，周围三种射线箭头：波浪、圆点、粗箭头
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram surrounded by three kinds of ray arrows: wavy lines, small dots and thick heavy arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 一个人一年里，受到三种射线照射。
overlay: 当量剂量：看射线种类

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：看射线种类
shots.scene: 三个徽章，粗箭头的徽章最大
shots.prompt_en: Three grade badges of different sizes; the badge for the thick heavy arrow is the largest. No people.
shots.narration: 射线种类不同，伤害分量也不同。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量：看射线种类
shots.scene: 粗箭头的徽章闪光
shots.prompt_en: The largest badge, labelled with a heavy particle icon, glows. No people.
shots.narration: 手部α吸收200毫戈瑞，乘20得4希沃特。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：看器官
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里几个器官挂着不同大小的砝码
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with several organs, each hanging a weight of a different size. No people.
shots.narration: 再按器官的敏感程度，加权相加。
overlay: 有效剂量：看器官

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：看器官
shots.scene: 三块积木加在一起，变成一块
shots.prompt_en: Three blocks of different colors merge into one block. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来约49.8毫希，就是有效剂量。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：看器官
shots.scene: 小研惊讶地看着一个最大的积木块，上面是手的图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks surprised at the biggest block, which carries a hand icon.
shots.narration: 手上受的α照射，贡献反而最大。

shots.section_title: 有效剂量：看器官
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign seriously.
shots.narration: 射线种类，和吸收多少同样重要。

shots.section_title: 局部受照要单独核对，超限必须报告
shots.scene: 手的图标发红，旁边是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon glowing red, with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 全身数字没超，局部却可能超了。
overlay: 局部受照要单独核对，超限必须报告

shots.section_title: 局部受照要单独核对，超限必须报告
shots.scene: 两把尺子：一把量全身，一把量手
shots.prompt_en: Two rulers: one measuring a whole body outline, one measuring a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 手部4希沃特，远超每年500毫希的限值。

shots.section_title: 局部受照要单独核对，超限必须报告
shots.scene: 王老师在空白报告单上盖章
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stamps a blank report form at her desk.
shots.narration: 超了就要报告，查明原因。

shots.section_title: 局部受照要单独核对，超限必须报告
shots.scene: 源罐、能量波形和射线图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a column: a source container, a wave shape and a ray arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用源前，先弄清是什么源和射线。

shots.section_title: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期
shots.scene: 一个慢得几乎不动的沙漏，旁边一个快一些的排水口
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass whose sand barely moves, beside a drain flowing steadily. No people.
shots.narration: 镭衰变极慢，身体排出却快得多。
overlay: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期

shots.section_title: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期
shots.scene: 两个出口的水箱，小出口几乎不起作用
shots.prompt_en: A tank with two outlets where the tiny outlet barely matters and the larger outlet drains most of the water. No people.
shots.narration: 有效半衰期约43.77年，由排出决定。

shots.section_title: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期
shots.scene: 一根平直的线被打叉，一根下降的线打勾
shots.prompt_en: A flat horizontal line crossed out with a red X, and a gently falling curve with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 只看衰变，会以为骨里一直不减。

shots.section_title: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，指着打叉的线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head and points to the crossed-out flat line.
shots.narration: 那样算，会把剂量算得过高。

shots.section_title: 镭在骨中：别只看物理半衰期
shots.scene: 人体模型图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A simple body model icon with arrows between organs and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 要用有效半衰期或生物动力学模型。

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 肺部图标吸入几粒尘埃，尘埃随后进入骨骼
shots.prompt_en: A lungs icon breathing in a few dust specks, which then move into a bone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入后进入骨头，可以留存几十年。
overlay: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 一卷长长的时间轴，上面持续亮着小光点
shots.prompt_en: A long rolled-out timeline with small glowing dots all along it. No people.
shots.narration: 把今后多年的剂量，一次记在当年。

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 进入量图标乘以一张系数卡
shots.prompt_en: An intake icon multiplied by a blank coefficient card. No people.
shots.narration: 进入量乘剂量系数，就是待积剂量。

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 骨头图标里有粗箭头α，旁边红色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A bone icon with thick heavy alpha arrows inside, and a red warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 钻进骨头的α核素，最危险。

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白系数卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank coefficient card and a calculator.
shots.narration: 系数9.5毫希每贝可，100贝可得0.95希。

shots.section_title: 待积剂量：亲骨α核素最危险
shots.scene: 一根柱子比限值线高出几十倍
shots.prompt_en: A tall bar rising far above a short red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 约是年职业限值的50倍。

shots.section_title: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留
shots.scene: X射线机房和隔壁办公室的剖面图，中间一堵墙
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway view of an X-ray room and an adjoining office separated by one wall. No people.
shots.narration: 案例一：X光机房隔壁是办公室。
overlay: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留

shots.section_title: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留
shots.scene: 三个图标：机器、坐着的人、穿墙的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a machine, a seated person, and an arrow passing through a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 要算机器用多少，人待多久，墙挡多少。

shots.section_title: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留
shots.scene: 墙后的表盘指针偏高，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dial behind the wall showing a high reading, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 5个半值层透射三十二分之一，每年282毫希。

shots.section_title: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留
shots.scene: 墙后的普通员工图标旁红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary office worker icon behind the wall with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 原来的墙远不够，普通员工都超限。

shots.section_title: 屏蔽设计要算工作量和居留
shots.scene: 老李用巡测仪在墙外测量，旁边空白验收单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures outside the wall with a blank survey meter, a blank checklist on a clipboard nearby.
shots.narration: 机房启用前，屏蔽要实测验证。

shots.section_title: 孕期员工：先调岗，再加固
shots.scene: 小研轻抚腹部，坐在办公桌前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, visibly pregnant, sits at an office desk, resting a hand on her belly.
shots.narration: 如果隔壁坐着一位怀孕的员工呢？
overlay: 孕期员工：先调岗，再加固

shots.section_title: 孕期员工：先调岗，再加固
shots.scene: 胎儿图标被一个小盾牌保护
shots.prompt_en: An unborn baby icon protected by a small shield. No people.
shots.narration: 胚胎胎儿最敏感，限值更严。

shots.section_title: 孕期员工：先调岗，再加固
shots.scene: 王老师把小研带到远离机房的另一间办公室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads the female graduate student to another office far from the X-ray room.
shots.narration: 先调岗离开，这一步马上就能做。

shots.section_title: 孕期员工：先调岗，再加固
shots.scene: 老李带人加厚墙体，旁边日历翻页
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adds an extra layer to the wall while a calendar beside him flips pages.
shots.narration: 再加约7.3个半值层，铅2.2厘米，要时间。

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 医院走廊图标，地上一个发光小胶囊，几个人形图标走过
shots.prompt_en: A hospital corridor icon: a small glowing capsule on the floor and several walking person pictograms passing by. No people.
shots.narration: 案例二：治疗用的源，被遗落在走廊。
overlay: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 人形图标离胶囊有一段距离，旁边短时钟
shots.prompt_en: Walking person pictograms stay at some distance from the capsule, with a short clock beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 铱-192源，45分钟后才发现，约10人路过。

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 1.5米处的表盘，旁边30秒的小时钟
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon at a distance marker, with a small stopwatch showing thirty seconds. No people.

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 人形图标很低的风险条
shots.prompt_en: A person icon next to a tiny risk bar far below a threshold line. No people.
shots.narration: 风险约百万分之八，低于确定性阈值。

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 5米外表盘指针
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon placed farther away at a five meter marker. No people.
shots.narration: 讲义算5米处降到75毫伦每时。

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 一个小人在胶囊旁站很久，长时钟和红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A stick figure standing right next to the capsule for a long time, with a long clock and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 要是在1.5米处待两小时，约4.2伦。

shots.section_title: 遗失源：短暂路过也要登记
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白名单逐一登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes names on a blank list on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 所有可能受照的人，都要登记评估。

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 六个编号空白圆圈排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Six numbered blank circles arranged in a column like a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 遗失源应急，要按顺序来。
overlay: 遗失源应急的先后顺序

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 小胶囊被放回运输容器，盖子合上
shots.prompt_en: A small capsule is placed back into a shielded transport container and the lid closes. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，立即收回源，放回运输容器。

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 警戒带拦住走廊两端，人形图标被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: Barrier tape blocks both ends of the corridor; person pictograms are kept outside. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，清场，别让更多人靠近。

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边是辐射安全负责人和学院图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; icons of a radiation safety officer and a college building appear beside her.
shots.narration: 第三，通知辐射安全负责人和医院管理层。

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 名单、报告单、放大镜和循环箭头图标依次出现
shots.prompt_en: Icons appear one by one: a list, a report form, a magnifying glass and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 再登记人员、报监管机构、查根因、改程序。

shots.section_title: 遗失源应急的先后顺序
shots.scene: 低剂量图标旁仍盖着报告印章
shots.prompt_en: A small dose icon with a report stamp beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 计划外源事件，剂量再低也要报告。

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 地下室剖面图，墙缝里冒出淡淡的气体，窗户紧闭
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a poorly ventilated basement lab with sealed windows; faint gas wisps seep up through floor cracks. No people.
shots.narration: 案例三：地下室里研究铀矿石样品。
overlay: 氡：通风差的地下实验室

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白录取通知，面露犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank offer letter, looking hesitant in the basement doorway.
shots.narration: 阿杰收到邀请，可这里氡浓度很高。

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 测氡仪表盘指针越过一条参考线
shots.prompt_en: A blank radon monitor dial whose needle passes a reference line. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度约800贝可每立方米，超过参考水平。

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 时钟、日历和一张系数卡
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clock, a calendar and a blank coefficient card. No people.
shots.narration: 全年约24毫希，按1920工时约5.3毫希。

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 两根柱子：5.3和1
shots.prompt_en: Two bars, one much taller than a short public limit bar. No people.
shots.narration: 远超公众每年1毫希的限值。

shots.section_title: 氡：通风差的地下实验室
shots.scene: 欣欣用放大镜看系数卡的空白脚注
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot checks the blank footnote of a coefficient card with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 系数里藏着假设，一定要看清。

shots.section_title: 氡为什么特别危险
shots.scene: 氡气泡飘出，变成小颗粒附在空气尘埃上
shots.prompt_en: Gas bubbles drift out and turn into tiny particles that stick to dust in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 子体钋-218、钋-214会附在尘埃上。
overlay: 氡为什么特别危险

shots.section_title: 氡为什么特别危险
shots.scene: 肺部图标，气管分支内壁亮起小红点
shots.prompt_en: A lungs icon whose bronchial branches show small red dots on the inner lining. No people.
shots.narration: 吸进去，沉积在支气管上皮。

shots.section_title: 氡为什么特别危险
shots.scene: 粗箭头α击中DNA双螺旋，断成几段
shots.prompt_en: Thick heavy alpha arrows hit a DNA double helix, breaking it in several places. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子造成的成团损伤，难以修复。

shots.section_title: 氡为什么特别危险
shots.scene: 香烟图标与氡图标相加，红色警示变大
shots.prompt_en: A cigarette icon plus a radon icon, producing a much larger red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 吸烟会让风险成倍放大。

shots.section_title: 氡为什么特别危险
shots.scene: 地球图标旁一个肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to a lungs icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 矿工数据充分，氡是全球第二大肺癌病因。

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 地下室装上排风扇，新鲜空气箭头流入
shots.prompt_en: The basement now has an exhaust fan; fresh air arrows flow in and stale air flows out. No people.
shots.narration: 加强通风，是最有效的一招。
overlay: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 地面裂缝被封堵，底板下方有抽气管
shots.prompt_en: Floor cracks are sealed and a suction pipe draws air from beneath the floor slab. No people.
shots.narration: 封堵裂缝，地板下减压抽气。

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 墙上一台测氡仪持续显示空白读数
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted blank radon monitor with a steady glowing display. No people.
shots.narration: 持续监测，确认措施真的有效。

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 阿杰和老周谈话，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks with the older man, who nods in agreement.
shots.narration: 降到参考水平前，不进地下室工作。

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 把整改作为接受职位的条件。

shots.section_title: 降氡措施与合理可行尽量低
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，旁边向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to a downward arrow icon.
shots.narration: 没超限值，也要尽量降低。

shots.section_title: 单位速查：新旧单位对照
shots.scene: 左右两列空白卡片，用箭头一一相连
shots.prompt_en: Two columns of blank cards linked one-to-one by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 最后，记牢新旧单位怎么对应。
overlay: 单位速查：新旧单位对照

shots.section_title: 单位速查：新旧单位对照
shots.scene: 小研在笔记本上画对照表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws a blank two-column table in her notebook.
shots.narration: 读文献看旧单位，别弄混了。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在八张题卡前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of eight question cards.
shots.narration: 八道题，总结成几句话。
overlay: 小结

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 尺子、时钟、砖墙三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green check marks: a ruler, a clock and a brick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 距离、时间、屏蔽，要一起算。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里亮着的器官和骨头
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a glowing neck organ and glowing bones. No people.
shots.narration: 体内照射，看核素聚在哪、留多久。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 射线徽章和器官砝码图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grade badge and an organ weight. No people.
shots.narration: 射线看种类，器官看敏感，局部单独查。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 电话、警戒带和登记本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a telephone, barrier tape and a logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 源遗失：收回屏蔽、清场、报告。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 排风扇和循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exhaust fan and a circular improvement arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 氡要通风降下来，不当作不可避免。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣合上习题册，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the exercise book and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 会算更会防，下次课见！
